card.name: Inside transdermal and SELinux terms
card.fires_on: The ending piece of a few specific words: 'mal' in 'transdermal' (mostly fentanyl patch text) and '_r' in SELinux labels like system_u:object_r. Also 'ates' in 'Substrates'.

modes.label: Transdermal
modes.description: The 'mal' ending of 'transdermal' in fentanyl patch dosing or contraindication text.
modes.example: at least 60 mg oral morphine per day, 25 mcg transder<<mal>> fentanyl per hour, 30

modes.label: SELinux labels
modes.description: The '_r' in role names such as object_r or system_r in security context output.

modes.label: Substrates
modes.description: The 'ates' ending of 'Substrates' in drug interaction headings.
modes.example: ( 2.4 , 7.1 ) • CYP2D6 Substr<<ates>>: Avoid concomitant use with V
